observations: Photos show a removed vehicle gearbox/transmission assembly with attached wiring/hoses and external housings.
Photo 0 shows the top/side of the gearbox with multiple ports/connectors and a large cast housing.
Photo 1 shows the opposite side with a visible electrical connector/wiring harness and another cast section.
Photo 2 shows the end/bell-side of the gearbox with a large circular cover/plate and cast ribs.

claims.claim: Dealer in all kinds of Japanese parts and gearbox
claims.evidence: Seller’s text only; photos show a gearbox but do not prove the seller’s business scope.

risks.risk: Exact gearbox type/model (and compatibility with the buyer’s car) is not readable from the photos, so it may not fit or match the required transmission code.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the gearbox identification plate/sticker and/or stamped transmission code (close-up, readable) plus the vehicle make/model/year it came from.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used Japanese gearbox with unknown compatibility (worst case: may not fit).

risks.risk: Unknown working condition (may be faulty, slipping, noisy, or missing internal parts). Photos only show the exterior.
risks.proof: Video of the gearbox being tested (engaged in gears) or a short bench test showing it shifts properly; include a sound check.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working (worst case: treat as faulty/for parts).

risks.risk: Missing components/accessories (sensors, solenoids, mounts, linkage, starter/adapter parts) that affect installation and operation.
risks.proof: Photo checklist: show all ports/connectors, mounting points, and any included accessories laid out; confirm what is included in the package.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: buyer may need to source missing parts).

risks.risk: Fluid leaks or damaged seals/casing not obvious in these angles; could fail soon after installation.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all seams, drain/plug areas, and any wet/oily spots; plus a wipe-and-recheck video after a short run (if testable).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potential leak risk (worst case: may leak and require reseal).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the gearbox ID plate/sticker or stamped code (readable).
Photo of the full gearbox label/part number and the vehicle it came from (make/model/year).
List of what is included (starter/adapter, sensors, harness, mounts) with photos of missing/extra parts.
response.reason: The photos confirm a gearbox/transmission assembly, but the exact model/compatibility and working condition cannot be verified remotely from these images, so a safe worst-case price cannot be determined without the key identification and test proof.
